surfaces.condition: A material feature, functionality, behavior, CLI/API, workflow, data, integration, security/privacy, or quality/release change is added or changed.
validation: Update this matrix in the same change with affected surfaces, contracts, documentation, tests, evidence, owners, and projections.
For a purely internal refactor or isolated fix with no matrix impact, record a reviewed no-impact reason in the same change record; omission is not an implicit no-impact decision.

surfaces.path: quality_runner/, quality_evidence_contract/, repo_quality_certifier/, and public documentation
surfaces.condition: scan, policy, finding, CLI, certification, or public documentation behavior changes
validation: For maturity changes, verify dimension-to-capability-to-pillar aggregation, reverse producer coverage, explicit capability applicability, evidence coverage, missing capabilities, and confirmed-risk-only critical caps.

surfaces.path: installed qr, plugins, Pronto, quality-runner-maturity-feed/v2, and quality-runner-repository-maturity/v2
surfaces.condition: command, plugin, feed schema, taxonomy, publication behavior, maturity pillar, applicability, coverage, cap, or source-dimension changes
validation: consumer contract readback in Pronto, including v1 migration labeling and v2 capability/pillar projection

surfaces.path: .mac-control/ideal-state.json, the installed validator, and the public maturity contract
surfaces.condition: manifest schema, semantic dimension, source grounding, provider boundary, score, or disposition behavior changes

surfaces.path: private fleet inventories, Pronto wiring, machine paths, credentials, and operator planning
surfaces.condition: a change depends on a particular workstation, private repository, account, or fleet inventory
